text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Parliament approved a 6,433 billion Lebanese pounds ($4.15 billion) state budget for 1997 with a 36 percent deficit of income against expenditure.
-Prime Minister Hariri will visit the Vatican at the end of February.
-Austrian Foreign Minister will arrive in Beirut on February 22 on a two-day visit.
-Hariri said there would be no war in the region as the solution is a political one.
-The military court sentenced 22 Lebanese men to up to 20 years in prison with hard labour for collaborating with Israel and planning attacks on Syrian forces.
-Foreign Minister Bouez said he expected an Israeli escalation of violence in south Lebanon.
-Weekly treasury bill issue of January 30 raised 535.9 billion Lebanese pounds and all yields fell, the finance ministry said.
-Net income of Solidere was $58.5 million and profits rose 81 percent in 1996 due to strong land sales in the war-damaged Beirut Central District it is rebuilding.
-Brazilian Foreign Minister Luiz Felipe Lamperia starts a three-day visit to Lebanon.
-Hariri said we will not privatise any productive sector.
